about_the_game:
In this demo of The Lonesome Guild, you'll embark on a heroic adventure as Ghost, a spirit who wakes to find they hold no memories. Meet and fight alongside two of six of your new companions – Davinci and Mr. Fox! Get a taste of the battles, exploration, and puzzles that await in The Lonesome Guild, including the very first boss fight! You’ll also experience the beginning of the rich story and expansive world of Etere.

Disclaimer: This demo of The Lonesome Guild is intended for demonstration purposes and is not the final product. The final version of the game will be released this Fall 2025 and will see improvements and polish. We appreciate your understanding and feedback!
